notes: Real black/dark grey mulch film; no green LOD0 canopy hull. Young plants have no fruit or flowers.

Film/soil ends are intentionally open; do not fill them during import. Skirt reaches -0.15 m.

allowed_open_boundaries: film skirt longitudinal bottom edges at Z=-0.15
